57|## Mariam Shelley
58|
59|Mariam Shelley is a lawful good halfling commoner and the owner of the Spark & Flame, the best—and only—tavern in Coldmore.
60|
61|She is normally bold, energetic, and relentlessly cheerful, but worry for her missing husband and daughter has left her withdrawn and tense.
62|
63|**Personality:** Bold and energetic; currently worried about her family.  
64|**Appearance:** Rosy cheeks, thick blond curls, and strong forearms.  
65|**Desire:** Retrieve her family and restore joy to Coldmore.  
66|**Fear:** The dissolution of her community.
67|
68|> “What’ll it be? Grandma’s Old Peculiar? Liverwort ale? How about nightshade for those bloody beasts out there.”

70|Mariam willingly shares the following information:
71|
72|- The creatures attack travelers in the forest but have not been seen near Coldmore.
73|- Hunters have found villagers, travelers, and animals savagely mauled.
74|- Some locals believe a pack of dire wolves is responsible.
75|- Franklin and Claire have been missing for two days.
76|- An experienced hunter sent after them never returned.
77|- A necromancer once ruled the woods and cursed the region.

84|| 8th | 550 gp | 1,250 gp | 4,500 XP |

49|### The Roach Clip: Quiet Component Recovery
50|
51|A coded tip from [[The Roach Clip]] reaches Barnabas through one of his traveling regulars. It offers discreet payment for anyone willing to recover unusual biological and mechanical components from the creature responsible for the attacks. The anonymous buyer does not want official attention and may be connected to [[Ashen Shadow Society Creature Utilisation & Neutralisation Taskforce|ASSCUNT]], which is interested in dangerous specimens, monster parts, and biomantic materials. Barnabas does not know the buyer’s identity, but he knows which adventurers can be trusted with a quiet job and passes the tip to them over the bar.

The Twilight Hunter.md (102 Words) lets flesh this out a little. Who is the offer from and what are their motives.

<user_selected_content path="content/Adventures/DM Notes/FLS/Tier 1/The Twilight Hunter.md" startLine="49" endLine="57">
```content/Adventures/DM Notes/FLS/Tier 1/The Twilight Hunter.md
49|### The Roach Clip: Quiet Component Recovery
50|
51|A coded tip from [[The Roach Clip]] reaches Barnabas through one of his traveling regulars. The offer comes from [[Kezrin Malvek]], director of the [[Ashen Shadow Society Creature Utilisation & Neutralisation Taskforce|ASSCUNT]], though Kezrin hides the Society’s involvement behind an anonymous broker.
52|
53|Kezrin does not know the creature’s full nature, but ASSCUNT has been collecting reports from the [[Grim Forest]] and [[The Outback]]: survivors describe a predator that moves on two legs, shifts between animal and humanoid features, uses both teeth and manufactured blades, avoids fire, and seems to vanish into shadows. The wounds also show an unusual mixture of bites, claws, and precise metal cuts. To Kezrin, that pattern suggests a biomantic or Magitech-enhanced Construct rather than an ordinary beast. A report forwarded through [[Dr. Stein]]’s research network gives the theory enough credibility for ASSCUNT to place a recovery offer before the official investigation confirms it.
54|
55|ASSCUNT wants the Bloodhound’s biological and mechanical components for the [[Ashen Citadel]]. Its researchers hope to study how the creature combines living tissue, harvested blood, and Magitech replacements without immediately collapsing. Kezrin is especially interested in the Bloodhound’s blood, claws, bones, pelt, and any intact transformation apparatus. The material could improve ASSCUNT’s monster-harvesting methods, support the Society’s biomantic research, or become the basis for equipment designed to track, restrain, or exploit similar creatures.
56|
57|Kezrin does not want the [[Tribunal Highblade Coalition]], [[N.E.R.D]], or rival researchers learning what ASSCUNT has recovered, so the party is offered discreet payment and told not to ask where the components are going. Barnabas does not know the buyer’s identity, only that the offer is legitimate and unusually generous. He passes the tip to adventurers he trusts, leaving the party to decide whether the extra money is worth concealing valuable evidence from the official investigation.
```
</user_selected_content>
